verdict: Meta is carrying all leads; Google spend is being redirected now.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 32 leads at an average cost of $117.77 per lead — all of them from Meta, while Google Ads spent $2,014.67 and produced zero leads. That confirmed spend leak is the primary reason your cost per lead rose 45% week-over-week, and Google budget is being reallocated away from the non-performing campaigns. Instagram reach also dropped sharply this week, a sign of creative fatigue, and fresh ad creative is being introduced to address it. Next period, you should see cost per lead begin to stabilize as spend is concentrated on the channel that is actually converting.

watch_item.issue: Google Ads has spent over $2,000 this period without generating a single lead, inflating your overall cost per lead significantly.
watch_item.fix: Budget is being moved away from the non-converting Google campaigns and consolidated into Meta, where leads are actively coming in.
